reviews.x: I've tried a lot of different patchouli products, but this is my absolute favorite! I really like straight patchouli oil, but unless you're hanging with hippies or going to a show, it can be too strong and powerful for everyday use - especially at work. Most blends either just don't smell that great or don't have enough patchouli. This blend is absolutely perfect. I've been using it for about a year now, and at least a couple times a week, someone walks by and tells me I smell wonderful. My supe

So shoot me for being an old hippie!  I still love the fragrance of patchouli and in this spray it's lightened with orange, so it's not overpowering.  The better of the two sprays with patchouli.  The other one 'Chill Pill' adds mint to the mix and is reminiscent of the way 'Sen-Sen' tasted.  Took me a while to remember that one, but that's what it is.

reviews.t: It reminds me of back in the day ...
reviews.x: If you're a Boomer it will bring back some memories maybe. If you're younger it will likely remind you of some older, but cool,  relatives.

I like this scent.  Rather than smell like Tangerine or Grapefruit it smells more like the skin of any citrus fruit.  Not at all overpowering but gets the job done.  I love to cook and eat broccoli and cauliflower which has an odor to other members of my family who can't stand it.  With a spray or two of the Tangerine & Grapefruit, all the nasty odors are gone.  And the kitchen doesn't smell icky sweet like I poured a bottle of perfume in the sink.  Now if we could only figure out a way to get t

Great mint smell. I get compliments whenever someone walks into my office.  Very soothing and refreshing without being overpowering. Poured some in smaller spray pump for my small purse to have on hand.
The absolute best mint spray I’ve ever had! I use this all over the house and on myself and hair the scent really lasts. This is pure mint smell not artificial or a perfumes mix.

I absolutely love this spray, and it is not always easy to find because it is so popular. I am happy that Amazon carries it now.  I spay it on m sheets every night before I go to bed and it definitely helps me to relax and sleep more comfortably! Try it, you’ll love it, too!
Whenever  I used Febreze air freshener I had to sneeze, making me wonder what was inside that can! I searched EWG.org and found this Aromatherapy mist. LOVE IT!

reviews.t: Good scent but not very powerful
reviews.x: This spray is a mix of eucalyptus and other essences. It smells good but it does feel a bit watered down, especially compared to pure eucalyptus.
Great. refreshing, like walking into a spa for a massage. HATE that I am forced to write 10 more words to submit............

reviews.t: Great Spider Deterrent for the Home!
reviews.x: We use this in our home as a natural deterrent for spiders. It's tough to spray for these critters with normal bug killer, as they have to track through it for it to be effective. But they don't like peppermint and will avoid the area entirely. We live in a rural area and in an older home, so bugs are a given. But peppermint spray is a wonderful kid-safe deterrent!  It also smells lovely. :) The only drawback is my cat loves it! And will try to lick it off furniture. So we spray it on curtains a

First and foremost, I'm a long-term fan of all things Aura Cacia. Their bath foams, mists, shower gels and essential oils are top notch, which is why I'm shocked to have just received a defective item. This spray has absolutely ZERO scent. To double check, I've compared this delivery with the same product purchased in a retail store; the aroma of the other one is distinctly and divinely Peppermint. What is going on at Amazon?

reviews.t: This spray really seems to neutralize bad smells
reviews.x: I use this in my home everyday. I also use it in my car. It seems to neutralize unpleasant smells. As a person who is chemically sensitive and unable to use most traditional room deodorizers or sprays. This is a product I can use that doesn’t adversely effect me, and actually works.  Only drawback is the size of the bottle. Wish it came in larger sizes. That being said, it doesn’t take a lot of this spray to be effective.

reviews.t: I love aura cacia's lotion of the same smell but this is heavier on the patchouli
reviews.x: The Aura Cacia sweet orange and patchouli body wash and body butter smell heavenly and I always get compliments when I use them. In those products, the patchouli is not as noticeable - the orange is much more prominent. In this spray, the patchouli is definitely the dominant scent. It's nice if you love patchouli - possibly a bit overwhelming if you only like patchouli somewhat - and definitely not for those who hate it.

reviews.t: Fresh and pleasant but no staying power.
reviews.x: The scent is super delicious. Like freshly peeled citrus. Smells incredibly fresh and invigorating. Unfortunately, I'm taking 2 stars away because the scent fades almost immediately! Like, you spray it, walk away, walk back & it's gone. I love that it's all natural, and it is extremely pleasant, just has no staying power. Perhaps if I added a little carrier oil to the mix that might help with longevity.

I have bought many a bottle of this, I totally love the scent. I even take it with me when I travel. The only warning I have is to use it up before it gets old. Because it’s an oil (I guess), it will eventually get old and smells a little off. I just had to learn not to save it — use it liberally and enjoy. When it’s gone, order a new bottle. It’s one of my favorites from this company.

reviews.t: This does NOT smell like eucalyptus.  By LCC
reviews.x: The description says that it is tested for purity and since I bought it from Swanson products, I trusted that.  It is Not pure at all!  It smells like a man's aftershave after it has gone rancid.  On top of all that, they will not accept a return.  I will have to reevaluate my trust of Aura Cacia and Swanson products for future purchases.

reviews.t: New product is a real disappointment
reviews.x: I’d used and loved this product for years. It was effective and lasting, leaving behind a pleasant scent. The new product is watery and overpriced. It is not worth the effort to pump.
Aura Cacia is my top choice for essential oils. I love the lavender mist for our bedroom. I use the mint mist on my feet during the hot summer and it really helps me stay cooler

reviews.t: I use it as insect repellant!
reviews.x: I got this in a gift set, and didn't use it much until recently, I sometimes go out to garden in the evening in the summer when it's cooler outside, but that's when mosquitoes are worse. I hate spraying myself with chemical bug spray, and hate the smell of it, but I was reading the label of this and figured lavender and eucalyptus would deter the bugs at least for a little while and it worked great! Now I smell great and my evening gardening is much more meditative without bugs sucking my blood!

This product is a nice Patchouli & sweet orange scent about ½ the time. VERY PROBLEMATIC the quality for this. It seems not a reliable trustworthy producer. That is a PROBLEM. Sorry but NO 50/50 shot... ¿? that's been my experience... first 3-4 times I got it, it was 👍 good!.. now 2 out of last 3 are Worthless (No Odor at all really, very faint! in bad ones ... heavily diluted... ¿??) That been my experience.

One spritz in the air after cooking and the room gets an amazing fresh, vibrant, clean scent. Potent and minty! Made of simple ingredients (peppermint oil, citrus oil) so it is safe around pets and children. I imagine it can be used in the same manner as 'Febreze' but the bonus of Aura Cacia is, no weird/harsh chemicals. I love it and will purchase again when this bottle is down.

reviews.t: Great scent, fades quickly in a room.
reviews.x: Depending on your need, this may be the perfect spray. As a room spray the scent is pleasant but dissipates quickly. Therefore not overwhelming, just lightly present. As a body spray it seems to have more staying power but will be more apparent to those around you as your nose acclimates to your own perfume. This is a good combination of sweet orange and patchouli.

Nice and not to over powering like some other products. It works well for me cause i shower on the reg and apply one or two sprays just to mellow out the air around me. Most people compliment me and say that they smell my light hippy foot print and they dig it cause a lot of people who choose Patchouli pile it on like crazy and its overwhelming and annoying.

reviews.t: I purchased in past essential oils and those were great, but these essential mists that company makes is ...
reviews.x: I have never purchase air mist from this company. I purchased in past essential oils and those were great , but these essential mists that company makes is a joke. Does not smell at all , it’s super super water dilated ! It doesn’t even smells in a very small tiny room .Not happy with it and I purchased 3 of them :(

claims.text: Reviewers frequently praise the pleasant, natural fragrance, often describing it as fresh and not overpowering.
Several reviewers note the scent fades quickly or is weaker than expected.
Some reviewers find the patchouli-dominant scent appealing, while others note it differs from related products where orange is more prominent.
Reviewers mention using the spray for practical purposes like neutralizing odors, deterring spiders, and aiding relaxation or sleep.
A few reviewers highlight that the product is suitable for chemically sensitive users or those avoiding traditional air fresheners.
